program.help:
Re-partition the selected cluster(s) with KlustaKwik (CEM Gaussian-mixture) on the PCA features of their waveforms. The output .clu is fed through the existing recluster integration so the new sub-clusters replace the source(s) on the active view, with one undo step.
This descriptor registers the built-in recluster backend as a plugin so an alternative backend can be dropped in beside it under the same interface.
